# Phonic

## Instructions for AI Agents

- For clean Markdown of any page, append `.md` to the page URL
- For section-specific indexes, append `/llms.txt` to any section URL
- For AI client integration (Claude Code, Cursor, etc.), connect to the MCP server at https://docs.phonic.ai/_mcp/server

## Docs

- [Introduction](https://docs.phonic.ai/docs/get-started/overview.md): Phonic is the speech-to-speech model company.
- [TypeScript SDK](https://docs.phonic.ai/docs/get-started/installation/typescript_sdk.md): Build voice agents with the Phonic TypeScript SDK.
- [Python SDK](https://docs.phonic.ai/docs/get-started/installation/python_sdk.md): Build voice agents with the Phonic Python SDK.
- [CLI](https://docs.phonic.ai/docs/get-started/installation/cli.md): Drive the Phonic API from your terminal.
- [MCP Server](https://docs.phonic.ai/docs/get-started/installation/mcp_server.md): Connect to the Phonic MCP
- [Agent Skills](https://docs.phonic.ai/docs/get-started/installation/skills.md): Give your coding agent specialized knowledge for building and testing Phonic voice agents.
- [Build Your First Agent](https://docs.phonic.ai/docs/get-started/build-your-first-agent.md)
- [Deploy Your First Agent](https://docs.phonic.ai/docs/get-started/deploy-your-first-agent.md): Four ways to run agents on Phonic: the agent builder, webhooks, WebSockets, or LiveKit.
- [Voices](https://docs.phonic.ai/docs/build/agents/voices.md): The voices available for Phonic agents, with the voice ID to use in the API.
- [Pronunciation Dictionary](https://docs.phonic.ai/docs/build/agents/pronunciation-dictionary.md): Control how your agent says brand names, product names, and other domain terms.
- [Multilingual Agents](https://docs.phonic.ai/docs/build/agents/multilingual.md): Configure which languages your agent speaks and how it switches between them.
- [Supported Languages](https://docs.phonic.ai/docs/build/agents/supported_languages.md): The 51 languages Phonic agents can recognize and speak, with the language code to use in the API.
- [Template Variables](https://docs.phonic.ai/docs/build/agents/template-variables.md): Fill per-conversation details into your agent's prompt and greeting, and use built-in system variables such as the date, the caller's number, and a recap of the caller's past conversations.
- [Prompting Guide](https://docs.phonic.ai/docs/build/agents/prompting_guide.md)
- [Evals Guide](https://docs.phonic.ai/docs/build/agents/evals_guide.md)
- [Replaying Conversations](https://docs.phonic.ai/docs/build/agents/replay.md): Re-run a recorded turn — or a whole call — to test a prompt change before you deploy it.
- [Tools Overview](https://docs.phonic.ai/docs/build/tools/tools_overview.md): Learn about the tool types available on Phonic, how they run (sync vs async), and how to configure their behavior — both in the Phonic dashboard and through the API.
- [Webhook Tools](https://docs.phonic.ai/docs/build/tools/webhook_tools.md): Call your own HTTP endpoint when the agent invokes a tool.
- [WebSocket Tools](https://docs.phonic.ai/docs/build/tools/websocket_tools.md): Run tools on your own server during a WebSocket conversation.
- [Context Tools](https://docs.phonic.ai/docs/build/tools/context_tools.md): Inject additional context into the conversation on demand.
- [Transfer Tools](https://docs.phonic.ai/docs/build/tools/transfer_tools.md): Transfer a call to a phone number or hand it off to another Phonic Agent.
- [MCP Tools](https://docs.phonic.ai/docs/build/tools/mcp_tools.md): Expose tools from a connected Model Context Protocol server.
- [Built-in Tools](https://docs.phonic.ai/docs/build/tools/built_in_tools.md): Enable Phonic's built-in tools by adding them to an agent's tools list.
- [How Tools Execute](https://docs.phonic.ai/docs/build/tools/how_tools_execute.md): A visual guide to how a tool call is sequenced against the agent's speech, using a shared timeline: what the baseline looks like, and how each configuration flag changes it.
- [Conversations via Webhooks](https://docs.phonic.ai/docs/build/with-webhooks/via-webhooks.md)
- [Agent Configuration Endpoint](https://docs.phonic.ai/docs/build/with-webhooks/agent-configuration-endpoint.md)
- [Webhooks](https://docs.phonic.ai/docs/build/with-webhooks/post-call-webhooks.md): Learn how to use Phonic webhooks
- [conversation.ended](https://docs.phonic.ai/docs/build/with-webhooks/post-call-webhooks/conversation-ended.md)
- [conversation.analysis](https://docs.phonic.ai/docs/build/with-webhooks/post-call-webhooks/conversation-analysis.md)
- [conversation.transferred](https://docs.phonic.ai/docs/build/with-webhooks/post-call-webhooks/conversation-transferred.md)
- [Conversations via WebSockets](https://docs.phonic.ai/docs/build/with-web-sockets/via-web-sockets.md)
- [Push to Talk](https://docs.phonic.ai/docs/build/with-web-sockets/push_to_talk.md)
- [Live Conversation WebSocket (Preview)](https://docs.phonic.ai/docs/build/with-web-sockets/live_websocket.md)
- [With LiveKit](https://docs.phonic.ai/docs/build/with-livekit.md): Run Phonic agents inside LiveKit Agents with the livekit-plugins-phonic realtime plugin.
- [SIP Trunk (Twilio, Telnyx)](https://docs.phonic.ai/docs/phone-numbers/using_custom_phone_numbers.md): Learn how to use your Phonic Voice Agent to send and receive calls to custom phone number via SIP trunking
- [Amazon Connect](https://docs.phonic.ai/docs/phone-numbers/amazon_connect.md): Learn how to use Phonic with Amazon Connect by bridging an Amazon Chime SDK Voice Connector to Phonic over SIP for inbound and outbound calls
- [Authentication](https://docs.phonic.ai/docs/platform/authentication/overview.md): Choose the right authentication mechanism for your use case.
- [Session Tokens](https://docs.phonic.ai/docs/platform/authentication/session-tokens.md): Mint short-lived tokens from your API key for use in browser and mobile clients.
- [Authenticating with JWTs](https://docs.phonic.ai/docs/platform/authentication/jw-ts.md): Mint short-lived JWTs in your own auth system and have Phonic verify them, scoped per user and per conversation.
- [Audit Logs](https://docs.phonic.ai/docs/platform/audit-logs.md): Pull SIEM-ready audit logs covering identity, configuration, and data-handling events for your workspace.
- [Data Retention](https://docs.phonic.ai/docs/platform/retention.md): Control how long Phonic retains conversation transcripts, audio, and derived artifacts.
- [Rate Limits](https://docs.phonic.ai/docs/platform/rate_limits.md)

## OpenAPI Specification

The raw OpenAPI 3.1 specification for this API is available at:
- [OpenAPI JSON](https://docs.phonic.ai/openapi.json)
- [OpenAPI YAML](https://docs.phonic.ai/openapi.yaml)


## AsyncAPI Specification

The raw AsyncAPI 2.6.0 specification for the WebSocket channels is available at:
- [AsyncAPI JSON](https://docs.phonic.ai/asyncapi.json)
- [AsyncAPI YAML](https://docs.phonic.ai/asyncapi.yaml)
